name: playtime-ranks
author: Takaro
description: Playtime Ranks: promotes players up a ladder of Takaro roles by total playtime (e.g. Newbie 0 h, Regular 10 h, Veteran 50 h, Legend 200 h). Each rank can grant a role (so ranks unlock permissions like more teleports), pay a one-time currency reward, send a PM and broadcast. A cron job checks online players; players use 'rank' and 'ranks', admins use 'rankcheck <player>'. Roles are never taken away for a higher rank than the player earned.

ranks.title: Rank ladder
ranks.description: Ranks ordered by the hours of playtime needed. Pick a Takaro role per rank to unlock that role's permissions. A rank without a role is a title plus reward only. Rank names must be unique: rewards are remembered by name.

roleId.title: Role
roleId.description: Takaro role given at this rank (optional).

message.title: Promotion PM
message.description: Private message on reaching this rank. Empty uses the default promotion message. Placeholders: {player}, {rank}, {hours}, {reward}, {currency}, {prefix}.

playtimeSource.title: Playtime source
playtimeSource.description: 'server' counts playtime on this game server only. 'global' counts playtime on all game servers in your Takaro domain.

removePreviousRoles.title: Remove previous rank roles
removePreviousRoles.description: When promoted, remove the roles of lower ranks. Roles of higher ranks are never removed.

roleScope.title: Role scope
roleScope.description: 'server' gives the rank role on this game server only. 'global' gives it on every game server.

promotionMessage.title: Default promotion PM
promotionMessage.default: Congratulations {player}! You reached the rank {rank} after {hours} h of playtime. Type {prefix}rank to see your progress.
promotionMessage.description: Used when a rank has no own message. Placeholders: {player}, {rank}, {hours}, {reward}, {currency}, {prefix}.

rewardMessage.title: Reward PM
rewardMessage.description: Sent when a rank reward is paid. Empty sends nothing. Placeholders: {player}, {rank}, {reward}, {currency}.

broadcastMessage.title: Promotion broadcast
broadcastMessage.default: {player} has reached the rank {rank} after {hours} h on the server!
broadcastMessage.description: Sent to everyone on a promotion. Empty disables broadcasts. Placeholders: {player}, {rank}, {hours}.

permissions.description: Allows using rankcheck to view and re-check another player's playtime rank.

rank.description: Show your playtime rank and the time to the next rank
rank.helpText: Shows your current playtime rank, your hours played and how long until the next rank.

ranks.helpText: Lists every playtime rank with the hours needed and its reward.

rankcheck.description: Admin: check and apply a player's playtime rank
rankcheck.helpText: Admin command. Shows a player's playtime and rank, and promotes them now if they are due.

check-ranks.description: Checks online players' playtime and promotes them to the rank they earned.
